title: A Reynolds-Semi-Robust, Globally Divergence-Free HDG Method for the Smagorinsky Model
summary: We develop and analyze a fully discrete, globally divergence-free hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) method for a gradient-based Smagorinsky model. The method combines backward Euler time stepping, interior-penalty discretizations of molecular and nonlinear eddy diffusion, and an upwind convective flux. The discrete velocity is $H(\operatorname{div})$-conforming and pointwise divergence-free, which yields pressure robustness.
